newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers firm, rest of Europe stable, calm.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers firm, rest of Europe stable, calm.

text.p: Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers edged higher on Friday, while most prices in Europe were unchanged, dealers said.
Almost all areas saw only thin business.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil was sold as low as $88 fob, but mostly at 50 cents to $1 a tonne higher than that. The price increase came amid rumours that one player was trying to bid up the market.
Total ARA demand reached about 10,000 tonnes, concluding a poor week of volumes traded.
Hamburg prices dipped slightly as supply difficulties faded. At around $90/$91 fob, the levels were barely higher than in Rotterdam, but few buyers expressed interest.
Mediterranean prices were broadly stable and demand poor. The exception was southern France where shortages caused a $2/$3 a tonne rise in fuel oil levels.
Fujairah bunkers gained $1 a tonne during another day of busy trading. Brokers said supplies were very tight until the middle of next week after a number of ships lifted in the last few days.
